pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Free forever for organizers. Hotels choose the plan that fits their goals — all prices in Saudi Riyal (SAR).
pricing.organizerDesc: Unlimited Group Requests, compare hotel quotations, message hotels directly, negotiate and manage contracts. No platform fees, ever.
pricing.hotelBasicDesc: List your hotel, receive matching Group Requests, submit quotations. Commission only on awarded bookings.
pricing.hotelProDesc: Everything in Free Listing, plus priority placement, priority Group Requests, analytics dashboard, enhanced profile, additional images and priority support.
pricing.hotelPremiumDesc: Everything in Professional, plus featured badge, homepage placement, top search placement, featured destination listings and premium support.
pricing.enterpriseDesc: For hotel chains, large hospitality groups and multi-property operators. Multi-property management, dedicated account manager, API access, PMS integrations, custom reporting, unlimited team members and custom workflows.
